# Patient admission to 3D (Oncology Ward) for Bispecific Antibody Administration

-HemOnc RN Care Manager to enter Leaf request for patient admission.

-Oncologist will notify the 3D Nurse Manager of the patient admission

request and inform Inpatient Medicine/Hospitalist Team and MICU Medical

Director.

# Provider to order Home Monitoring through Home Telehealth to include:

blood pressure, thermometer, pulse oximeter.

Home Monitoring should be ordered at least a week prior to patient receiving

medication to allow time for setup.

-Oncologist to order Home Telehealth Orders under Hypertension Orders for now

AND Teams Adam Herr, Director of Innovative Technologies, with patient info.

# Tarlatamab Orders

Patient to be seen by Oncologist in 3V HemOnc Clinic the day prior to admission.

Oncologist to place order for Tarlatamab for patient in VCM the day prior to

to admission.

Patient to report to ward 3D at 8:00am for admission for Bispecific treatment.

IF patient lives greater than 50 miles from the medical center they may lodge

in Building 10 located across the street from the medical center the

night before admission.

Patient Lodging Office 4G-109/Building 70

Phone: (612) 467-4289
